wording: In dynamical-systems usage, the global Lyapunov exponent is taken to represent the average rate of divergence of neighbouring trajectories, and the most popular candidate definition of chaos (Chaos_lambda) is a positive global Lyapunov exponent.
counterevidence_limits: P09 also reports objections: Lyapunov exponents are asymptotic quantities and Chaos_lambda is one of several definitions.
operationalization: Divergence = exponential separation of nearby trajectories
verification_phrases: P09|average rate of divergence of neighboring trajectories || P09|A function is chaotic if it has a positive global Lyapunov exponent

wording: There is no consensus on a precise definition of chaotic behaviour: mathematicians often prefer one definition and scientists another, so 'divergence of trajectories' is one operationalization among competitors, not the definition of chaos.
locator: P09 section on definitions and predictability
operationalization: Competing definitions of chaos (sensitive dependence vs topological definitions)
verification_phrases: P09|There is no consensus regarding a precise definition of chaotic behavior
